subject: R0.04 SIWC control runtime probe prerequisite
reviewMode: read-only source review; no physical runtime or AT verification

findings.finding: The existing verifier checks ancestor ownership and write bits but does not establish that the measured UID/GID 310 can traverse every ancestor left unchanged. The probe opens only control and control/releases. A root-owned Toy ancestor at mode 0700 passes the current verifier but still denies the dropped child access to the release.
findings.impact: The root operation can open protected parents and launch the child without establishing the path-access precondition needed for the actual-identity import/read proof. The child then fails to reach the staged payload.
findings.requiredCorrection: Before either chmod, validate UID/GID 310 traversal through the full fixed ancestor chain (or fail closed on any ancestor whose observed ownership/mode does not permit it).

findings.finding: Parent-mode restoration relies on JavaScript finally only. Default SIGINT/SIGTERM termination exits Node without running that finally block while control and releases are temporarily mode 0711.
findings.impact: An ordinarily interrupted root request can leave existing protected parent modes changed, violating the preservation and restoration invariant.
findings.requiredCorrection: Make ordinary signal termination enter a restoration path before exit, or require and verify a separately guaranteed restoration step before treating the operation as runnable.

staticChecks.newProbeRootRequestEntry: not present in build/ROOT-REQUESTS.md at review time

scopeDeviation: An initial inventory command included read-only git status, and an accidental read-only stat inspected /Library and /Library/Application Support. Neither action changed files or system state; no Toy runtime, root command, browser, service, or Keychain operation was performed.
